   d.Stroke.Transparency=active and .28 or .82
  end
  page.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(page.CanvasPosition.X,page.CanvasPosition.Y)
 end

 -- FEATURE ACCORDION ---------------------------------------------------
 local featureOrder=0
 function X:Feature(page,title,desc,opts)
  opts=opts or{};featureOrder+=1
  local accent=ak(opts.Accent)
  local opened=opts.Expanded==true

  local f=New("Frame",{
   LayoutOrder=opts.Order or featureOrder,
   BackgroundTransparency=.52,
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),
   AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
   ClipsDescendants=true,
   ZIndex=15,
   Parent=page
  })
  bind(f,"BackgroundColor3","Panel")
  featureGlass(f)
  Round(f,11)

  local fs=Stroke(f,T.Stroke,.70)
  bind(fs,"Color","Stroke")

  New("UIListLayout",{
   Padding=UDim.new(0,0),
   SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
   Parent=f
  })

  local h=New("TextButton",{
   AutoButtonColor=false,
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50),
   LayoutOrder=1,
   Text="",
   ZIndex=16,
   Parent=f
  })

  -- V14.3:
  -- NO large colored block behind the header.
  -- Serenity keeps only the thin accent rail + tiny accent dot.
  local rail=New("Frame",{
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,8),
   Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,34),
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(rail,"BackgroundColor3",accent)
  Round(rail,999)

  local dot=New("Frame",{
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,13),
   Size=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(dot,"BackgroundColor3",accent)
  Round(dot,999)

  local titleLabel=New("TextLabel",{
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Position=UDim2.fromOffset(25,5),
   Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,20),
   Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
   Text=title,
   TextSize=12,
   TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(titleLabel,"TextColor3","Text")

  local descriptionLabel=New("TextLabel",{
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Position=UDim2.fromOffset(25,26),
   Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,16),
   Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
   Text=desc or"",
   TextSize=9,
   TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
   TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(descriptionLabel,"TextColor3","Dim")

  -- Neutral Serenity pill. Accent is used only for border/text.
  local statePill=New("Frame",{
   AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),
   Position=UDim2.new(1,-34,.5,0),
   Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,20),
   BackgroundTransparency=.50,
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(statePill,"BackgroundColor3","Panel3")
  Round(statePill,999)

  local stateStroke=Stroke(statePill,T[accent],.64)
  bind(stateStroke,"Color",accent)

  local stateText=New("TextLabel",{
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
   Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
   Text=opened and"OPEN"or"VIEW",
   TextSize=8,
   ZIndex=18,
   Parent=statePill
  })
  bind(stateText,"TextColor3",accent)

  local arrow=New("TextLabel",{
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),
   Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),
   Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),
   Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
   Text=opened and"v"or">",
   TextSize=11,
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(arrow,"TextColor3","Soft")

  -- Very thin neutral divider, closer to V13's visual hierarchy.
  local divider=New("Frame",{
   BackgroundTransparency=opened and .72 or 1,
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-1),
   Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,1),
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=h
  })
  bind(divider,"BackgroundColor3","Stroke")

  local c=New("Frame",{
   BackgroundTransparency=1,
   Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),
   AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
   Visible=opened,
   LayoutOrder=2,
   ZIndex=16,
   Parent=f
  })

  New("UIPadding",{
   PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),
   PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8),
   PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),
   Parent=c
  })

  New("UIListLayout",{
   Padding=UDim.new(0,6),
   SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
   Parent=c
  })

  local id=tostring(featureOrder)
  local item={
   Frame=f,
   Content=c,
   Expanded=opened,
   Page=page,
   Id=id
  }

  local function render()
   c.Visible=item.Expanded
   arrow.Text=item.Expanded and"v"or">"
   stateText.Text=item.Expanded and"OPEN"or"VIEW"

   fs.Transparency=item.Expanded and .36 or .70
   stateStroke.Transparency=item.Expanded and .40 or .64
   divider.BackgroundTransparency=item.Expanded and .72 or 1

   local configured=math.clamp(
    tonumber(C.FeatureTransparency) or 48,
    28,
    78
   )/100

   local target=item.Expanded
    and math.max(.34,configured-.05)
    or configured

   Tw(f,.13,{BackgroundTransparency=target})
   Tw(statePill,.13,{
    BackgroundTransparency=item.Expanded and .38 or .50
   })
  end

  function item:Open()
   if item.Expanded then
    return
   end

   X:CloseActivePopup()

   if not page:GetAttribute("AllowMultipleFeatures")then
    local old=page:GetAttribute("OpenFeatureId")

    if old and X.Features[old]and X.Features[old]~=item then
     X.Features[old]:Close()
    end
   end

   item.Expanded=true
   page:SetAttribute("OpenFeatureId",id)
   render()
  end

  function item:Close()
   if not item.Expanded then
    return
   end

   X:CloseActivePopup()
   item.Expanded=false
   render()
  end

  function item:Toggle()
   if item.Expanded then
    item:Close()
   else
    item:Open()
   end
  end

  h.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
   item:Toggle()
  end)

  h.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
   Tw(fs,.10,{
    Transparency=item.Expanded and .24 or .54
   })
   Tw(stateStroke,.10,{
    Transparency=item.Expanded and .28 or .50
   })
  end)

  h.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
   render()
  end)

  X.Features[id]=item

  if opened then
   page:SetAttribute("OpenFeatureId",id)
  end

  render()
  return c,item
 end

 -- CONTROL HELPERS -----------------------------------------------------
 local controlOrder=0
 local function row(parent,height)
  controlOrder+=1
  local r=New("Frame",{
   LayoutOrder=controlOrder,
   BackgroundTransparency=.34,
   BorderSizePixel=0,
   Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 48),
   ZIndex=17,
   Parent=parent
  })
  bind(r,"BackgroundColor3","Panel2")
  controlGlass(r)
  Round(r,9)

  local s=Stroke(r,T.Stroke,.82)
  bind(s,"Color","Stroke")

  r.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
   Tw(r,.10,{BackgroundTransparency=math.max(.18,(tonumber(C.ControlTransparency)or 34)/100-.08)})
   Tw(s,.10,{Transparency=.62})
  end)

  r.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
   Tw(r,.10,{BackgroundTransparency=math.clamp((tonumber(C.ControlTransparency)or 34)/100,.18,.62)})
   Tw(s,.10,{Transparency=.82})
  end)

  return r
 end
 local function labels(r,t,d,space)local a=New("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-(space or 90),0,18),Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text=t or"",TextSize=11,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=18,Parent=r});bind(a,"TextColor3","Text");local b=New("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,22),Size=UDim2.new(1,-(space or 90),0,15),Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,Text=d or"",TextSize=9,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=18,Parent=r});bind(b,"TextColor3","Dim");return a,b end

 function X:Action(parent,title,desc,cb,opts)
  opts=opts or{};local r=row(parent,46);local ac=ak(opts.Accent);labels(r,title,desc,105);local b=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(opts.Width or 76,27),BackgroundTransparency=.66,BorderSizePixel=0,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text=opts.ButtonText or"RUN",TextSize=9,ZIndex=19,Parent=r});bind(b,"BackgroundColor3",ac);bind(b,"TextColor3",ac);Round(b,7);local st=Stroke(b,T[ac],.5);bind(st,"Color",ac)
  local armed=false;local serial=0;b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()if opts.Confirm and not armed then armed=true;serial+=1;local x=serial;b.Text=opts.ConfirmText or"AGAIN";task.delay(opts.ConfirmTimeout or 2.2,function()if armed and serial==x and b.Parent then armed=false;b.Text=opts.ButtonText or"RUN"end end);return end;armed=false;serial+=1;b.Text=opts.ButtonText or"RUN";if cb then task.spawn(cb)end end);return{Row=r,Button=b}
 end

 function X:Switch(parent,key,title,desc,default,cb,opts)
  opts=opts or{};local r=row(parent,46);local ac=ak(opts.Accent);local state=default==true;labels(r,title,desc,72)
  local tr=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-9,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,22),BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",ZIndex=19,Parent=r});Round(tr,999)
  local k=New("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,11,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=20,Parent=tr});Round(k,999)
  local item={};local function render()tr.BackgroundColor3=state and T[ac]or T.Track;k.BackgroundColor3=state and T.Text or T.Dim;Tw(k,.11,{Position=state and UDim2.new(1,-11,.5,0)or UDim2.new(0,11,.5,0)})end
  function item:Set(v,silent)state=v==true;render();if key then X:SetConfig(key,state,silent)end;if not silent and cb then task.spawn(cb,state)end end;function item:Get()return state end;X.ThemeRefreshers[#X.ThemeRefreshers+1]=render;tr.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()item:Set(not state,false)end);item:Set(state,true);if key then X.Items[key]=item end;return item
 end

 function X:Select(parent,key,title,desc,values,default,cb,opts)
  opts=opts or{};values=CopyArray(values);local holder=New("Frame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,Parent=parent});New("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,4),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=holder});local r=row(holder,46);r.LayoutOrder=1;local value=default or values[1];local ac=ak(opts.Accent);labels(r,title,desc,166)
  local sel=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(140,28),BackgroundTransparency=.44,BorderSizePixel=0,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text=tostring(value or"Select"),TextSize=9,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=19,Parent=r});bind(sel,"BackgroundColor3","Panel3");bind(sel,"TextColor3",ac);Round(sel,7);New("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8),Parent=sel})
  local menu=New("Frame",{LayoutOrder=2,BackgroundTransparency=.12,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),Visible=false,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=20,Parent=holder});bind(menu,"BackgroundColor3","Panel2");Round(menu,8);local ms=Stroke(menu,T[ac],.55);bind(ms,"Color",ac)
  local list=New("ScrollingFrame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8),CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ScrollBarThickness=2,ZIndex=21,Parent=menu});bind(list,"ScrollBarImageColor3",ac);New("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,3),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=list})
  local open=false;local item={_Selector=sel,_Menu=menu}
  local function rebuild()for _,o in ipairs(list:GetChildren())do if o:IsA("TextButton")then o:Destroy()end end;for i,v in ipairs(values)do local o=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundTransparency=tostring(v)==tostring(value)and .38 or .78,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,-2,0,28),LayoutOrder=i,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text="  "..tostring(v),TextSize=9,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=22,Parent=list});bind(o,"BackgroundColor3","Panel3");bind(o,"TextColor3","Soft");Round(o,6);o.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()item:Set(v,false);item:Close()end)end end
  function item:Open()
   if open then return end
   X:ActivatePopup(item)
   open=true
   menu.Visible=true
   menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,math.min(#values,6)*31+8)
  end

  function item:Close(fromManager)
   if not open then
    if not fromManager then X:DeactivatePopup(item)end
    return
   end

   open=false
   menu.Visible=false
   menu.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)

   if not fromManager then
    X:DeactivatePopup(item)
   elseif X.ActivePopup==item then
    X.ActivePopup=nil
   end
  end
  function item:Set(v,silent)local good=false;for _,x in ipairs(values)do if tostring(x)==tostring(v)then v=x;good=true;break end end;if not good then return false end;value=v;sel.Text=tostring(v);rebuild();if key then X:SetConfig(key,v,silent)end;if not silent and cb then task.spawn(cb,v)end;return true end;function item:Get()return value end
  sel.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()if open then item:Close()else item:Open()end end);rebuild();if key then X.Items[key]=item end;return item
 end

 function X:MultiSelect(parent,key,title,desc,values,defaults,cb,opts)
  opts=opts or{};values=CopyArray(values);local holder=New("Frame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,Parent=parent});New("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,4),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=holder});local r=row(holder,46);r.LayoutOrder=1;local selected=SelectionSet(defaults);local ac=ak(opts.Accent);labels(r,title,desc,166)
  local sel=New("TextButton",{AutoButtonColor=false,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(140,28),BackgroundTransparency=.44,BorderSizePixel=0,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,Text="",TextSize=9,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=19,Parent=r});bind(sel,"BackgroundColor3","Panel3");bind(sel,"TextColor3",ac);Round(sel,7);New("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8),Parent=sel})
